name: TTB — Storage
sourceNotes: Mapped from the user-provided form edition. Blank quantities remain unknown; enter zero explicitly where appropriate. Shaded cells are unavailable. No business identities, source quantities, signatures, or sample reporting periods are included. Approval in this application does not sign the official form.

sections.title: Plant and reporting period
sections.description: Select the report coverage and enter the plant identity and reporting month. The source form calls for separate reports for domestic, imported, Puerto Rican, and Virgin Islands spirits; domestic coverage also includes all wines.

sections.title: Column and transaction descriptions
sections.description: Identify column (k) and the blank transaction lines 5 and 21 when used.

sections.title: Storage operations — proof gallons
sections.description: All columns on this form, including wine, are proof gallons. Lines 7–16 are withdrawals for the named use. Line 6 totals lines 1–5; line 24 totals lines 7–23. Each line total includes only the available commodity columns. Balance checks compare lines 6 and 24 for each column. Consult the source form footnotes for classification and withdrawal qualifications.
